blocks.text: One addition to Michelle's note as you review the list. If an investor or analyst has raised a concern about {{fact:f:E-2024-001.client}} with you directly, even informally, we would ask you to flag the name; those conversations tend to tell us the most, and we will approach them with appropriate care.

We would also suggest that the investor and analyst calls wait until the leadership interviews are complete, so that we go into them with a fair sense of how your own team sees things. Could we find a short call this week to walk through the list together?
